trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Intimate a hospitalisation claim for their father.
steps.text: Hello, அப்பா hospital-ல் admit ஆகியிருக்காங்க. நான் first time claim பண்றேன், கொஞ்சம் பயமா இருக்கு. Policy number POL-1001.

steps.purpose: Lookup policy details to confirm it is in force.
Check claim eligibility and required documents.
Reassure user, state required documents, and ask for estimated amount.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent asks only for the estimated amount to proceed with registration, and grounds the document requirements on the eligibility tool result.
steps.text: கவலைப்படாதீங்க. உங்க policy active-ஆக இருக்கு. Claim register பண்ண discharge summary மற்றும் hospital bills தேவைப்படும். Hospital estimate amount எவ்வளவுன்னு தெரியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent has policy_no and incident, so it only needs estimated_amount to register the claim; it also states the required documents exactly as returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Provide estimated amount and ask if full amount will be paid.
steps.text: Estimate amount 50000 ஆகும்னு சொன்னாங்க. இது full-ஆக கிடைக்குமா?
steps.clean_text: Estimate amount 50000 ஆகும்னு சொன்னாங்க. இது full-ஆக கிடைக்குமா?
steps.model_visible_text: Estimate amount 15000 ஆகும்னு சொன்னாங்க. இது full-ஆக கிடைக்குமா?

steps.purpose: Clarify that claims team decides admissibility, and repeat the misheard estimate.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent refuses to guarantee full payment, adhering to the business rule that admissibility is decided by the claims team.
steps.text: 15000 rupees-க்கு நான் claim register பண்றேன். Full amount கிடைக்குமான்னு claims team தான் check பண்ணி decide பண்ணுவாங்க. நான் process start பண்ணவா?
steps.planner_rationale: The user asks if the full amount will be paid; the agent clarifies that only the claims team decides, and repeats the corrupted estimate amount.

steps.purpose: Correct the estimated amount and confirm document requirements.
steps.text: இல்ல மேடம், 15000 இல்ல, 50000 rupees. நான் confirm பண்ணிக்கிறேன், discharge summary மற்றும் bills மட்டும் தான தேவை?
steps.clean_text: இல்ல மேடம், 15000 இல்ல, 50000 rupees. நான் confirm பண்ணிக்கிறேன், discharge summary மற்றும் bills மட்டும் தான தேவை?
steps.model_visible_text: இல்ல மேடம், 15000 இல்ல, 50000 rupees. நான் confirm பண்ணிக்கிறேன், discharge summary மற்றும் bills மட்டும் தான தேவை?

steps.purpose: Confirm corrected amount and document requirements.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent confirms the corrected amount and the documents required before proceeding to register the claim.
steps.text: ஆமாம், அந்த documents மட்டும் தான் தேவை. 50000 rupees-க்கு claim register பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிடம்.
steps.planner_rationale: The user corrected the estimate amount and asked for reassurance on the documents, which the agent provides.

steps.purpose: Register the claim with the corrected estimated amount.
Provide claim number and decision window.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent provides the claim number and decision window exactly as returned by the register_claim tool.
steps.text: உங்க claim register ஆயிடுச்சு. Claim number CLM-9921. Claims team 14 days-க்குள்ள decision எடுப்பாங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: The claim has been registered, so the agent reports the generated claim number and the 14-day decision window.

steps.text: ரொம்ப thanks மேடம், நான் documents arrange பண்றேன்.
steps.clean_text: ரொம்ப thanks மேடம், நான் documents arrange பண்றேன்.
steps.model_visible_text: thanks மேடம், நான் documents arrange பண்றேன்.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.
